title: Import a road line
description: Bring an existing line from a GeoJSON file in as an editable road on the training terrain.

setup.goal: Import a line as a new road and check that the terrain supplies its ground.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: The readings are those of the synthetic training terrain and the Hillside access roads as shipped.

check.description: Training spur is the active road

overlay.title: Choose the line file
overlay.body: Select Import road line and choose training-spur.geojson, the sample file in this lesson’s guide. The line becomes a new road.

overlay.title: Check the active road
overlay.body: Road name reads Training spur, the name in the file: the imported road is now the active one.

overlay.title: Check its ground
overlay.body: The profile draws a ground line under the whole of the new road: the training terrain supplies elevations all along the line.
